subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Identificar sinônimos de palavras de texto lido, determinando a diferença de sentido entre eles, e formar antônimos de palavras encontradas em texto lido pelo acréscimo do prefixo de negação in-/im-.

components.description_pt: Identificar sinônimos de palavras encontradas em um texto lido
components.description_en: Identify synonyms of words found in a read text
components.cc_component_description: Identify relationships between words such as synonyms, antonyms, and analogies

components.description_pt: Distinguir diferenças sutis de significado entre palavras com denotações similares
components.description_en: Distinguish subtle differences in meaning among words with similar denotations
components.cc_component_description: Distinguish subtle differences in meaning among words with similar denotations

components.description_pt: Formar antônimos de palavras adicionando o prefixo negativo in- ou im-
components.description_en: Form antonyms of words by adding the negating prefix in- or im-
components.cc_component_description: Identify how adding a known prefix to a known word changes its meaning

cc_matches.description: Analyze nuances in the meaning of words with similar denotations.
Determine the meaning of the new word formed when a known affix is added to a known word (e.g., agreeable/disagreeable, comfortable/uncomfortable, care/careless, heat/preheat).
Demonstrate understanding of figurative language, word relationships, and nuances in word meanings.
